about.title: One Entity, Five Industry Strengths
about.p1: PT. Geya Mora Agung operates at the heart of the Belawan trading corridor and Malacca Strait. We integrate commodity trading, maritime logistics, warehousing, shipbuilding, and construction into one solid, fully-licensed business entity.
about.p2: Strategically located in Gaharu, East Medan — backed by complete OSS legality including API-P and DJBC customs access for import-export activities.

services.title: Comprehensive Portfolio
services.desc: From agricultural commodities to maritime infrastructure — GMA is the integrated partner for all business needs across North Sumatra.

why.title: Why GMA Is Your Premier Choice?

items.title: Complete & Verified Legality
items.text: Active OSS RI NIB with import API-P, DJBC customs access, and active BPJS — all legal documents ready for cross-border business activities.

items.title: Strategic Belawan–Kualanamu Network
items.text: Operating at North Sumatra's most strategic corridor: Belawan Port for sea routes and Kualanamu Airport for air cargo.

items.title: Integrated One-Stop Services
items.text: Trading, warehousing, maritime, and construction under one ecosystem. No need to coordinate with multiple vendors.

items.title: Sumatra Commodity Expertise
items.text: Deep knowledge of Sumatra's commodities: CPO, rubber, tropical fruits, marine products — we know the market prices and best distribution channels.

items.title: Fast Response & Professional
items.text: Experienced team committed to max 24-hour response. Trust, punctuality, and measurable results are our top priorities.

items.title: Flexible for All Business Scales
items.text: From SMEs to large corporations — our capacity, pricing, and services are tailored to your specific business needs.

items.q: What are PT. Geya Mora Agung's main services?
items.a: GMA operates in 5 sectors: agricultural commodity trading, shipbuilding & repair, warehousing & logistics, building construction, and marine transport equipment trading. 12 active KBLI codes registered in OSS RI.
Yes. GMA's NIB serves as API-P with official DJBC customs access rights. We assist with import procurement processes in full compliance with applicable regulations.

items.q: How do I start a partnership with GMA?
items.a: Contact us via WhatsApp or email. Our team will respond within 24 hours and prepare a proposal tailored to your requirements.

items.q: Does GMA serve areas outside of Medan?
items.a: GMA's NIB is valid across Indonesia. For trading and logistics, we reach partners throughout Sumatra, Java, and the Indonesian archipelago. Export services via Belawan Port.

items.q: What differentiates GMA from ordinary trading companies?
items.a: GMA is an integrated group combining trading, maritime, warehousing, and construction. One point of contact for all your business needs — efficient and structured.

items.q: Is there a minimum order requirement?
items.a: No rigid minimum order. We serve from SME to large corporate scale. Each need is assessed to determine the most mutually beneficial cooperation scheme.
